description: A PHP script for exporting test plan data in various XML formats within the TestLink open-source testing management project. It handles different export types such as 'tree', '4results', and 'linkedItems', generating corresponding XML content and facilitating file download. The script also initializes request arguments and GUI configurations for the export process.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters, returning an object with arguments for the export process, including export type, filename, and context.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI display variables based on test plan info and provided arguments, including filename, titles, and identifiers.
